newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Aramco faces millennium computer problem.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Aramco faces millennium computer problem.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil giant Saudi Aramco is moving to avoid a potentially disastrous computer meltdown when the new century begins.

The company has gathered together an in-house team of information technology specialists to carry out a study this month into the so-called "millennium bug", Aramco project analyst Abbas Al Mahel told a Dubai conference.
Aramco has day to day responsibility for some eight million barrels per day of oil production and refineries, parts of which are computer-aided.
The Dhahran-based firm says it will take at least 100 man-years to adapt all its computers to the new century.
The bug is a real fear in the computer world based on worries that computers will not be able to correctly recognise or process the changed date with the turn of the millennium.
